correctness.rationale: The five-dimensional real fourth homogeneous Wiener chaos generated by independent standard X,Y has the Wick-ordered orthogonal basis Φ₀=R²−8R+8, Φ₂c/s=R(R−6)cos/sin2θ and Φ₄c/s=R²cos/sin4θ. Polar independence and E R^m=2^m m! give Q=E F²=64a²+48|B|²+192|C|² and an explicit fourth-moment polynomial. Subtraction of 105Q² is exactly the five-term nonnegative identity involving 786432a⁴, 497664|B|⁴, 7077888a²|C|², 221184|B|²(a²+3|C|²), and 3760128|aB+conjugate(B)C|². Thus the lower ratio 105 is exact with equality precisely at nonzero harmonic quartics Re[z(X+iY)^4]. The standard fourth multiple Wiener integral product formula bounds E F⁴≤639Q²; rank-one contraction equality forces a one-coordinate H₄(v·(X,Y)), and examples attain 639. Independently checked basis variances and multiple integer-coefficient fourth moment/deficit witnesses. The checker additionally coefficientwise verifies all 70 fourth-moment monomials; finite checks verify that identity, while analytic tensor arguments prove the unrestricted bounds.
